description: AI-powered insurance fraud detection SaaS platform for MGAs at the point of submission. Implements 100+ fraud indicators across 16 document types with dual portals (white-labeled broker submission + underwriter dashboard).

userStories.title: Initialize project with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project scaffolded with the core tech stack so that all subsequent stories have a foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14+ app with TypeScript configured (strict mode)
Tailwind CSS installed and configured with a base theme (slate/blue color palette)
Prisma ORM installed with PostgreSQL provider configured
Project structure: src/app (pages), src/components, src/lib (utilities), src/services (business logic), prisma/ (schema)
ESLint and Prettier configured
Environment variables template (.env.example) with DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, S3_BUCKET placeholders
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use App Router. This is the foundation for the entire platform.

userStories.title: Database schema: tenants, users, and roles
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core multi-tenancy and auth schema so that users belong to MGAs with role-based access.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant table: id, name, slug, domain, logoUrl, primaryColor, secondaryColor, createdAt, updatedAt
User table: id, tenantId (FK), email, name, role (enum: ADMIN, UNDERWRITER, SENIOR_UNDERWRITER, SIU_INVESTIGATOR, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER, BROKER), passwordHash, mfaSecret, isActive, createdAt
Role enum defined in Prisma schema
Tenant-user relationship: one tenant has many users
Migration runs successfully and creates tables
Seed script creates a test tenant and one user per role
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All subsequent tables will have tenantId for multi-tenancy.

userStories.title: Database schema: submissions and documents
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the submission and document tables so that uploaded files can be tracked through the processing pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Submission table: id, tenantId (FK), submitterId (FK to User), insuredName, lineOfBusiness, status (enum: PROCESSING, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED, DECLINED, INFO_NEEDED, REFERRED_TO_SIU), riskScore (0-100 nullable), severity (enum: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, CLEAN nullable), channel (enum: PORTAL, EMAIL, API), assignedUnderwriterId (FK nullable), createdAt, updatedAt

Document table: id, submissionId (FK), tenantId (FK), fileName, fileType, fileSize, s3Key, documentType (enum: ACORD_125, ACORD_130, ACORD_140, LOSS_RUN, FINANCIAL_STATEMENT, COI, ENTITY_DOC, INSPECTION_PHOTO, MVR, SOV, SURPLUS_LINES, PROFESSIONAL_LICENSE, ENVIRONMENTAL_REPORT, PAYROLL_TAX, BROKER_SUBMISSION, FLEET_SCHEDULE, UNKNOWN), classificationConfidence (float), extractedData (JSON), status (enum: UPLOADED, CLASSIFYING, EXTRACTING, ANALYZED, ERROR), createdAt
Indexes on tenantId, submissionId, status, createdAt
Migration runs successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Database schema: fraud indicators, audit logs, thresholds
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tables for fraud detection results, audit trails, and configurable thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: FraudIndicator table: id, submissionId (FK), tenantId (FK), documentId (FK nullable), category (enum: CROSS_DOC, FORENSIC, STATISTICAL, TEMPORAL, RATIO, ENTITY_INTEL, VISUAL_AI, NLP, API_VERIFY, RULES), indicatorName, description, severity (enum: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), evidence (JSON - source values, references, variance), confidence (float 0-1), recommended_action, isOverridden (bool default false), overriddenBy (FK nullable), overrideJustification (text nullable), createdAt
AuditLog table: id, tenantId (FK), submissionId (FK nullable), userId (FK nullable), action (string), details (JSON), ipAddress, createdAt

ThresholdConfig table: id, tenantId (FK), lineOfBusiness (string nullable for global), autoApproveBelow (int default 20), autoEscalateAbove (int default 70), siuReferralOnCritical (bool default true), createdAt, updatedAt
Migration runs successfully
Seed script creates default threshold config for test tenant
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Database schema: SIU cases and white-label settings
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tables for SIU investigation tracking and per-tenant branding configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: SIUCase table: id, tenantId (FK), submissionId (FK), status (enum: OPEN, INVESTIGATING, EVIDENCE_GATHERED, CONFIRMED_FRAUD, FALSE_POSITIVE, INCONCLUSIVE), assignedToId (FK to User), notes (JSON array of {userId, text, timestamp}), evidence (JSON array of {type, url, description, timestamp}), resolution (text nullable), createdAt, updatedAt

WhiteLabelConfig table: id, tenantId (FK unique), logoUrl, primaryColor (default '#1e40af'), secondaryColor (default '#3b82f6'), accentColor (default '#f59e0b'), customDomain (nullable), customEmailDomain (nullable), termsUrl (nullable), privacyUrl (nullable), footerText (nullable), supportEmail (nullable), supportPhone (nullable), createdAt, updatedAt
Migration runs successfully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Auth service: JWT login, API key auth, and middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I need authentication so that users can log in and API consumers can authenticate with keys.
acceptanceCriteria: NextAuth.js configured with Credentials provider (email/password)
JWT session strategy with tenantId and role in token payload
API key table in schema: id, tenantId, key (hashed), name, permissions (JSON), isActive, createdAt, lastUsedAt
Auth middleware that extracts user from JWT or API key header (X-API-Key)
Login API route: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT token
Protected API route wrapper that checks auth and injects tenantId
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Multi-tenant middleware and role-based access control
userStories.description: As a developer, I need middleware that scopes all queries to the current tenant and enforces role permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: withTenant middleware that adds tenantId filter to all Prisma queries
withRole middleware that checks user role against required roles for each endpoint
Role hierarchy: ADMIN > SENIOR_UNDERWRITER > UNDERWRITER; SIU_INVESTIGATOR and COMPLIANCE_OFFICER are independent roles
BROKER role can only access submission portal endpoints (submit, track, view own submissions)
All API routes return 403 if role check fails
All queries automatically scoped to tenant (no cross-tenant data leakage)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Document upload API endpoint with S3 storage
userStories.description: As a broker, I need to upload documents via API so they are stored securely and tracked in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/submissions endpoint: creates a new submission record, accepts multipart file uploads
Files stored to S3 with path: {tenantId}/{submissionId}/{documentId}/{filename}
Document records created with status UPLOADED, file metadata captured (name, type, size)
Maximum 50 files per submission, 500MB total limit enforced
Accepted file types: PDF, XLSX, DOCX, JPG, PNG, TIFF
Returns submission ID and list of document IDs with upload status
S3 client configured with env vars (AWS_REGION, S3_BUCKET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use @aws-sdk/client-s3 for uploads.

userStories.title: Document classification service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to auto-classify uploaded documents by type so that the correct extraction pipeline is triggered.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function classifyDocument(documentId) that reads the file from S3 and determines document type
Classification based on: filename patterns, PDF text content keywords (ACORD 125, ACORD 130, etc.), page structure analysis
Returns one of 16 DocumentType enum values plus a confidence score (0-1)
Updates document record with documentType and classificationConfidence
Sets document status to CLASSIFYING during processing, then EXTRACTING on success or ERROR on failure
Handles: PDF (text extraction), images (basic OCR placeholder), spreadsheets (sheet name analysis)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use pdf-parse for PDF text extraction. Classification can start rule-based and upgrade to ML later.

userStories.title: ACORD 125 data extraction service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract structured fields from ACORD 125 Commercial Insurance Application forms.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function extractAcord125(documentId) that reads PDF content and extracts key fields

Extracted fields stored in document.extractedData JSON: applicantName, businessName, dba, mailingAddress, physicalAddress, naicsCode, yearEstablished, annualRevenue, numberOfEmployees, priorCarrier, priorPolicyNumber, priorPremium, lossDisclosure (boolean), requestedCoverages (array), effectiveDate, expirationDate
Handles both text-based and form-field-based PDFs
Sets document status to ANALYZED on success
Logs extraction confidence per field in extractedData metadata
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Start with regex/pattern-based extraction. Can upgrade to ML-based IDP later.

userStories.title: ACORD 130 and ACORD 140 data extraction services
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract structured fields from Workers' Comp (130) and Property (140) ACORD forms.
acceptanceCriteria: extractAcord130(documentId): extracts totalPayroll, payrollByClassification (array of {classCode, description, payroll, employeeCount}), eModRate, priorCarrier, experienceModWorksheet fields

extractAcord140(documentId): extracts propertyLocations (array of {address, buildingValue, contentsValue, businessIncomeValue, constructionType, yearBuilt, squareFootage, occupancy, condition}), totalInsuredValue, deductible
Both store results in document.extractedData JSON
Both set document status to ANALYZED on success
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Loss run and financial statement extraction services
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract data from loss runs and financial statements for cross-document validation.
acceptanceCriteria: extractLossRun(documentId): extracts carrier name, policyPeriod, claims (array of {claimNumber, dateOfLoss, claimType, status, paidAmount, reserveAmount, totalIncurred}), totalClaimCount, totalIncurred
extractFinancialStatement(documentId): extracts fiscalYear, revenue, costOfGoodsSold, grossProfit, operatingExpenses, netIncome, totalAssets, totalLiabilities, accountsReceivable, accountsPayable
Loss run normalization: maps varying carrier formats to standard schema
Both store results in document.extractedData JSON
Both set document status to ANALYZED on success
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: COI and entity document extraction services
userStories.description: As the system, I need to extract data from Certificates of Insurance and business entity documents.
acceptanceCriteria: extractCOI(documentId): extracts insuredName, insurerName, policyNumber, effectiveDate, expirationDate, coverageTypes (array), generalLiabilityLimit, autoLiabilityLimit, umbrellaLimit, workersCompLimit, agentName, agentEmail, agentPhone

extractEntityDocument(documentId): extracts entityName, entityType (LLC, Corp, etc.), stateOfIncorporation, incorporationDate, registeredAgent, registeredAgentAddress, officers (array of {name, title}), ein
Both store results in document.extractedData JSON and set status to ANALYZED
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Cross-document validation: revenue and payroll checks
userStories.description: As the system, I need to compare revenue across ACORD 125 vs financial statements and payroll across ACORD 130 vs tax docs.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function validateRevenue(submissionId): compares revenue from ACORD 125 extractedData vs financial statement extractedData
Flags >15% variance as HIGH severity, >25% as CRITICAL severity
Creates FraudIndicator record with category CROSS_DOC, evidence JSON containing both values and variance percentage
Service function validatePayroll(submissionId): compares total payroll from ACORD 130 vs payroll/tax document
Flags >$2,000 variance as HIGH, >10% variance as CRITICAL
Creates FraudIndicator record with evidence showing both values
Both functions skip gracefully if required documents are missing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Cross-document validation: employee count, loss history, property values
userStories.description: As the system, I need to cross-validate employee counts, loss claims, and property values across document types.
acceptanceCriteria: validateEmployeeCount(submissionId): ACORD 125/130 headcount vs payroll doc count. Flag >2 difference as HIGH
validateLossHistory(submissionId): count claims in submitted loss runs vs count on ACORD 125 loss disclosure. Flag any omitted claim as CRITICAL
validatePropertyValues(submissionId): ACORD 140 insured values vs tax assessor benchmark (2x assessed = HIGH, 3x = CRITICAL). Uses a configurable assessed-to-insured ratio
Each creates FraudIndicator records with structured evidence (source values, document references, variance)
All functions skip gracefully if required documents missing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: PDF metadata forensics service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to analyze PDF metadata to detect forged or altered documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function analyzePdfMetadata(documentId): reads PDF metadata (author, producer, creationDate, modDate)
Check 1: Flag if PDF creationDate is after the submission date (HIGH severity)
Check 2: Flag if multiple different PDF producers found across pages of same document (MEDIUM severity)
Check 3: Flag if author/producer is a personal name instead of expected software/carrier system (MEDIUM severity)
Check 4: Flag if document has no text layer (image-only PDF) preventing text verification (MEDIUM severity)
Creates FraudIndicator records for each flag with category FORENSIC
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use pdf-parse or pdf-lib for metadata extraction.

userStories.title: Statistical anomaly detection service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect statistical anomalies like round numbers and industry benchmark deviations.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function detectStatisticalAnomalies(submissionId): runs all statistical checks
Round-number detection: flag currency values that are exact multiples of $100K across all extracted financials (MEDIUM)
Revenue growth check: flag YoY revenue growth >30% from financial statements (HIGH)
COGS margin check: flag COGS as % of revenue deviating >15% from industry norm lookup table by NAICS code (HIGH)
Payroll-per-head check: flag per-employee payroll outside industry norms (<$25K or >$80K for classification) (HIGH)
Industry benchmark lookup table stored as JSON config (NAICS code -> expected ranges)
Creates FraudIndicator records with category STATISTICAL and evidence showing actual vs expected values
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Temporal analysis service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect temporal anomalies in dates across submission documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function detectTemporalAnomalies(submissionId): runs all temporal checks
Coverage gap detection: flag gaps >30 days in prior coverage from COI/loss run dates (HIGH)
Claim timing clusters: flag if >50% of claims occurred within 60 days of policy inception/expiration (HIGH)
Document staleness: flag inspection reports >6 months old, MVRs >30 days old, ESAs >12 months old (MEDIUM)
Impossible dates: flag if loss run effective date is before policy effective date (CRITICAL)
Creates FraudIndicator records with category TEMPORAL and evidence showing the date values and gaps
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Financial ratio analysis service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to calculate and evaluate financial ratios against industry benchmarks.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function analyzeFinancialRatios(submissionId): extracts ratios from financial statement data
DSO calculation: flag Days Sales Outstanding growing >20% while revenue increases (CRITICAL - fictitious revenue indicator)
A/R ratio: flag Accounts Receivable >40% of revenue (HIGH)
Profit margin: flag net profit margin exceeding industry average by >50% (MEDIUM)
Contents-to-building ratio: flag if outside expected range for classification (retail 20-40%, manufacturing 30-60%) (HIGH)
Creates FraudIndicator records with category RATIO and evidence showing calculated ratio vs industry benchmark
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Risk scoring engine with severity classification
userStories.description: As the system, I need to produce a composite fraud risk score (0-100) from all indicator results.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function calculateRiskScore(submissionId): aggregates all FraudIndicator records for the submission
Weighted scoring: CRITICAL indicators contribute 25 points each (max 100), HIGH = 15, MEDIUM = 5, LOW = 1
Score capped at 100
Severity classification: score >85 or any CRITICAL = CRITICAL, 60-85 = HIGH, 35-60 = MEDIUM, <35 = LOW, 0 indicators = CLEAN
Updates submission record with riskScore and severity
Score breakdown stored: JSON object with points per category (CROSS_DOC, FORENSIC, STATISTICAL, etc.)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the rule-based scorer. ML ensemble scorer is a future upgrade.

userStories.title: Auto-routing: approve, escalate, or refer based on thresholds
userStories.description: As the system, I need to automatically route submissions based on MGA threshold configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function routeSubmission(submissionId): reads ThresholdConfig for the tenant (and line of business if configured)
Score below autoApproveBelow AND no MEDIUM+ indicators: set status to APPROVED, create audit log entry
Score above autoEscalateAbove OR any CRITICAL indicator: set status to UNDER_REVIEW, assign to senior underwriter
siuReferralOnCritical enabled AND forged/fabricated document indicator present: set status to REFERRED_TO_SIU, auto-create SIU case
All other submissions: set status to UNDER_REVIEW for standard underwriter review
Creates AuditLog entry for every routing decision with reason
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Submission processing pipeline orchestrator
userStories.description: As the system, I need an orchestrator that runs all processing steps in sequence when a submission is uploaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function processSubmission(submissionId): orchestrates the full pipeline
Step 1: Classify all documents (classifyDocument for each)
Step 2: Extract data from all classified documents (appropriate extractor per type)
Step 3: Run all Phase 1 detection engines (cross-doc validations, forensics, statistical, temporal, ratio)
Step 4: Calculate risk score
Step 5: Route submission based on thresholds
Handles errors gracefully: if one document fails extraction, continues with remaining documents
Updates submission status: PROCESSING during pipeline, then routed status on completion
Creates AuditLog entry for pipeline start and completion with timing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This ties all detection services together into a single pipeline.

userStories.title: Audit logging service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to log every significant action for compliance and regulatory audit trails.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function logAudit(tenantId, action, details, userId?, submissionId?, ipAddress?): creates immutable AuditLog record

Actions logged: SUBMISSION_CREATED, DOCUMENT_UPLOADED, PROCESSING_STARTED, PROCESSING_COMPLETED, FRAUD_FLAG_RAISED, SUBMISSION_APPROVED, SUBMISSION_DECLINED, SUBMISSION_ESCALATED, SIU_REFERRAL, SCORE_OVERRIDE, THRESHOLD_CHANGED, USER_LOGIN
Details JSON includes: before/after values for changes, reason/justification for overrides
GET /api/audit-logs endpoint: returns paginated audit logs filtered by tenantId, submissionId, action, dateRange
Audit logs are append-only (no update/delete endpoints)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Notification service: email notifications
userStories.description: As the system, I need to send email notifications for key submission events.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function sendNotification(type, recipientEmail, data): sends templated email

Templates: SUBMISSION_RECEIVED (to broker), SUBMISSION_APPROVED (to broker), SUBMISSION_DECLINED (to broker), INFO_NEEDED (to broker with specifics), ESCALATION_NOTICE (to broker - generic 'under review' message), NEW_SUBMISSION_FOR_REVIEW (to underwriter), SIU_REFERRAL (to SIU investigator)
Email templates use tenant white-label settings (logo, colors, from address)
Templates do NOT reveal fraud detection logic or scores to brokers
Uses a configurable email provider (env var EMAIL_PROVIDER: sendgrid or smtp)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use @sendgrid/mail or nodemailer based on config.

userStories.title: Email intake service: parse inbound submission emails
userStories.description: As the system, I need to parse inbound emails and create submissions from their attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/intake/email webhook endpoint that receives parsed email data (from SendGrid Inbound Parse or similar)
Extracts sender email, subject line, and all attachments
Looks up tenant by recipient email address (submissions@{tenant-slug}.quantanashield.com)
Creates a new Submission record with channel=EMAIL and submitter identified by sender email
Uploads all valid attachments to S3 and creates Document records
Handles zip file attachments (extracts contents)
Sends auto-acknowledgment email to sender with submission ID and portal tracking link
Sends error notification if no valid attachments found
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Core API endpoints: submissions CRUD and status
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I need RESTful endpoints to manage submissions and check their status.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/submissions: list submissions for tenant, paginated, filterable by status, dateRange, severity, broker
GET /api/submissions/:id: full submission detail including documents, risk score, severity, status
POST /api/submissions: create submission with file uploads (already built in US-008, ensure it matches OpenAPI spec)
PATCH /api/submissions/:id/status: update status (approve, decline, request-info, refer-to-siu) with required justification for decline/override
GET /api/submissions/:id/indicators: list all fraud indicators for a submission
GET /api/submissions/:id/risk-report: full risk report with score breakdown, indicators, explainability text
All endpoints scoped to tenant, role-checked, and audit-logged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Threshold management API endpoints
userStories.description: As an MGA admin, I need API endpoints to view and update fraud detection thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/config/thresholds: returns current threshold config for tenant (global + per-LOB overrides)
PUT /api/config/thresholds: update global thresholds (autoApproveBelow, autoEscalateAbove, siuReferralOnCritical). Requires ADMIN role
PUT /api/config/thresholds/:lineOfBusiness: set per-LOB threshold override. Requires ADMIN role
DELETE /api/config/thresholds/:lineOfBusiness: remove per-LOB override (falls back to global). Requires ADMIN role
GET /api/config/thresholds/preview: accepts proposed thresholds, returns how last 30 days of submissions would have been routed differently
All changes create AuditLog entry with before/after values
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Webhook subscription and delivery system
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I need to subscribe to webhooks for submission events.
acceptanceCriteria: WebhookSubscription table: id, tenantId, url, events (JSON array of event types), secret (for HMAC signing), isActive, createdAt
POST /api/webhooks: create subscription with url, events array, returns secret
GET /api/webhooks: list active subscriptions for tenant
DELETE /api/webhooks/:id: deactivate subscription
Event types: submission.processed, submission.approved, submission.declined, submission.escalated, fraud.flag_raised, siu.case_created
Delivery function: POST to subscriber URL with JSON payload, HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Webhook-Signature header
Retry logic: 3 attempts with exponential backoff on failure
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Submission portal: layout, white-label theming, login page
userStories.description: As a broker, I need a branded login page and portal shell with the MGA's branding.
acceptanceCriteria: Portal route group at /portal with its own layout
Layout loads WhiteLabelConfig for the tenant (determined by subdomain or slug in URL)
Header shows tenant logo, nav links (New Submission, My Submissions, Profile)
Color scheme applied from tenant config (primary, secondary, accent colors as CSS variables)
No Quantana branding visible anywhere in the portal
Login page at /portal/login with email/password form, styled with tenant branding
Responsive design: works on desktop and tablet
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Submission portal: document upload page with drag-and-drop
userStories.description: As a broker, I need a drag-and-drop upload interface to submit documents for a new submission.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /portal/submissions/new
Form fields: Insured Name (required), Line of Business (dropdown), Effective Date (date picker)
Drag-and-drop upload zone that accepts PDF, XLSX, DOCX, JPG, PNG, TIFF files
Multiple file upload support (up to 50 files)
Per-file progress indicators during upload
File list shows: filename, size, upload status (uploading/complete/error)
Remove button to delete an uploaded file before submission
Submit button calls POST /api/submissions, then redirects to classification review step
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use react-dropzone for the drag-and-drop zone.

userStories.title: Submission portal: classification review and validation results
userStories.description: As a broker, I need to review auto-classified documents and see instant validation feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /portal/submissions/:id/review (shown after upload)
Shows list of uploaded documents with auto-detected type and confidence badge
Dropdown to correct misclassified documents (select from 16 document types + Unknown)
After classification confirmed, shows validation results section
Validation results grouped as: Action Required (red), Warning (yellow), Info (blue)
Each validation item shows: affected document, field, issue description, how to fix
Re-upload button to replace a document and re-validate
Confirm & Submit button finalizes the submission
No fraud scores or detection logic shown -- only data quality issues
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Submission portal: submission list and detail/status page
userStories.description: As a broker, I need to see all my submissions and track their status.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /portal/submissions showing list of broker's submissions
Table columns: Submission Date, Insured Name, Line of Business, Status (badge), Assigned Underwriter
Status badges: Processing (blue spinner), Under Review (yellow), Approved (green), Declined (red), Info Needed (orange)
Filter by status and date range, search by insured name
Click row navigates to /portal/submissions/:id
Detail page shows: submission info, list of documents with status, current status with timeline, messages/requests from underwriter
Notification badge on nav for submissions needing action (INFO_NEEDED status)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Underwriter dashboard: layout, navigation, and login
userStories.description: As an underwriter, I need a dashboard shell with navigation to all underwriter features.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard route group at /dashboard with its own layout
Sidebar navigation: Triage Board, Analytics, SIU Cases, Configuration, Audit Trail
Header shows: user name, role badge, tenant name, 'Powered by Quantana Shield' subtle branding
Login page at /dashboard/login for underwriter/admin/SIU roles
Role-based nav: SIU Cases only visible to SIU_INVESTIGATOR and ADMIN, Configuration only to ADMIN
Dark/light mode toggle in header
Responsive sidebar (collapsible on smaller screens)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Underwriter dashboard: triage board (kanban view)
userStories.description: As an underwriter, I need a kanban board showing all submissions organized by status.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /dashboard/triage
Kanban columns: New, In Review, Approved, Declined, Referred to SIU
Each submission card shows: insured name, broker name, LOB, date, risk score gauge (0-100 with color), severity badge (CRITICAL red, HIGH orange, MEDIUM yellow, LOW gray), indicator count
Cards sorted by risk score within each column (highest first)
Cards are draggable between columns (drag from New to Approved = approve action)
Click card opens submission detail in side panel or navigates to detail page
Filter bar: filter by severity, LOB, date range, broker
Bulk select checkbox + 'Approve Selected' button for LOW-risk batch approval
Typecheck passes

userStories.notes: Use @dnd-kit/core for drag-and-drop.

userStories.title: Underwriter dashboard: submission risk report detail view
userStories.description: As an underwriter, I need to see the full risk report for a submission with all fraud indicators and evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /dashboard/submissions/:id
Risk score section: large gauge chart (0-100), severity badge, score breakdown bar chart by category (Cross-doc, Forensic, Statistical, Temporal, Ratio)
Fraud indicators list: each indicator shows name, severity badge, description, evidence panel with source values and document references, confidence score, recommended action
Indicators sortable by severity (CRITICAL first) and filterable by category
Explainability section: plain-English summary of top risk factors
Historical context: if prior submissions exist from same entity/broker, show link and comparison
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use recharts or chart.js for the gauge and bar charts.

userStories.title: Underwriter dashboard: document viewer and action buttons
userStories.description: As an underwriter, I need to view source documents alongside extracted data and take actions on submissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Document viewer tab on submission detail page: side-by-side layout
Left panel: embedded PDF viewer showing the source document (use react-pdf or iframe)
Right panel: extracted data fields from that document, flagged fields highlighted in red/yellow
Document selector: dropdown to switch between documents in the submission
Action bar at bottom of detail page: Approve (green), Request More Info (orange), Decline (red), Refer to SIU (purple)
Decline and Override actions require a justification text input (modal)
Override risk score button (SENIOR_UNDERWRITER and ADMIN only): enter new score with justification
Mark as False Positive button on individual indicators (with justification)
All actions create AuditLog entries and trigger appropriate notifications
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Underwriter dashboard: threshold configuration page
userStories.description: As an MGA admin, I need a UI to configure auto-approve and escalation thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: Page at /dashboard/config/thresholds (ADMIN role only)

userStories.title: Phase 2: SOS entity verification service
userStories.description: As the system, I need to verify business entities against Secretary of State records.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function verifyEntity(submissionId): extracts entity name and state from ACORD 125 or entity documents
Calls SOS API (or mock/stub for MVP) to check: entity exists, active status, incorporation date, registered agent
Flag: entity not found = CRITICAL, entity inactive/dissolved = CRITICAL, incorporated <2 years with mature operations claimed = HIGH
Flag: registered agent address is virtual office or PO box = MEDIUM
Creates FraudIndicator records with category ENTITY_INTEL
Gracefully handles API failures with retry and fallback to manual verification queue
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Start with a mock API interface that can be swapped for real state APIs.

userStories.title: Phase 2: OFAC screening and broker license verification
userStories.description: As the system, I need to screen entities against sanctions lists and verify broker licenses.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function screenOFAC(submissionId): extracts all named entities and individuals, checks against OFAC SDN list
OFAC list loaded from CSV/JSON (updated periodically). Fuzzy name matching with configurable threshold
Any OFAC match = CRITICAL severity indicator
Service function verifyBrokerLicense(submissionId): extracts broker name and state from submission/cover letter
Checks against NIPR database (or mock for MVP): license exists, active status, disciplinary history
Broker not found = CRITICAL, license expired/suspended = CRITICAL, disciplinary actions = HIGH
Creates FraudIndicator records with category ENTITY_INTEL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Phase 2: Address classification and EIN validation
userStories.description: As the system, I need to classify business addresses and validate Federal EIN timing.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function classifyAddress(address): returns classification (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, VIRTUAL_OFFICE, PO_BOX) using address validation API (or heuristic for MVP)
Flag: registered agent or business address classified as virtual office or PO box for commercial entity = MEDIUM
Service function validateEIN(submissionId): extracts EIN from entity documents, checks issuance date
Flag: EIN filed <6 months before application date = HIGH
Flag: business incorporated <2 years with no web presence = HIGH (web presence check via simple domain/Google search heuristic)
Creates FraudIndicator records with category ENTITY_INTEL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Phase 2: Image forensics service (ELA, EXIF, copy-move)
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect manipulated photos in property inspection submissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function analyzeImage(documentId): runs image forensics on submitted photos
EXIF analysis: extract GPS coordinates, compare to claimed property address (>1 mile = CRITICAL). Flag stripped EXIF = HIGH
EXIF timestamp analysis: flag if photo timestamps span only minutes for multi-hour inspection = MEDIUM
Error Level Analysis placeholder: flag images with ELA anomalies (implement as stub returning low-confidence results, ready for ML model integration)
Copy-move detection placeholder: stub ready for ML model integration
Creates FraudIndicator records with category VISUAL_AI
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use exif-reader for EXIF extraction. ELA and copy-move are ML-heavy - stub for now.

userStories.title: Phase 2: GenAI forgery detection and template matching
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect AI-generated documents and verify document templates match expected formats.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function detectGenAIForgery(documentId): stub service that accepts a document and returns a forgery probability score (0-1)
Interface defined for future ML model integration: input = document bytes, output = {isLikelyForged: boolean, confidence: number, indicators: string[]}
Flag: isLikelyForged with confidence >0.7 = CRITICAL
Service function matchTemplate(documentId): compares document layout/structure against known templates for the document type
Template library: JSON config mapping document types to expected structural features (page count ranges, field positions, logo presence)
Flag: document format doesn't match expected state/carrier template = HIGH
Creates FraudIndicator records with category VISUAL_AI
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: GenAI detection is stub-ready for ML model. Template matching starts rule-based.

userStories.title: Phase 2: Broker cover letter NLP analysis
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect concealment, pressure tactics, and manipulation in broker narratives.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function analyzeBrokerLetter(documentId): extracts text from broker submission/cover letter
Pressure language detection: scan for keywords/phrases ('urgent', 'time-sensitive', 'need quick response', 'expiring today') = MEDIUM
Manipulation detection: scan for ('ignore', 'overlook', 'disregard', 'don't worry about', 'minor issue') = HIGH
Concealment check: cross-reference with loss runs - if letter doesn't mention known prior losses = CRITICAL
Declination detection: scan for evidence of prior coverage declinations not disclosed = HIGH
Creates FraudIndicator records with category NLP and evidence showing matched phrases with context
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Start with keyword/regex patterns. Can upgrade to transformer-based intent detection later.

userStories.title: Phase 2: VIN decoder and professional license verification
userStories.description: As the system, I need to validate vehicle identification numbers and professional licenses.
acceptanceCriteria: Service function decodeVIN(vin): calls NHTSA VIN decoder API to get year, make, model, vehicle type
Service function validateFleetVINs(submissionId): extracts VINs from fleet schedule documents, decodes each
Flag: VIN doesn't match stated year/make/model = CRITICAL
Flag: non-CDL driver assigned to commercial vehicle = HIGH
Service function verifyProfessionalLicense(submissionId): extracts license numbers from professional license documents
Checks against state board database (stub/mock for MVP): license exists, active, not expired/suspended
Flag: license not found = CRITICAL, expired/suspended = CRITICAL, scope mismatch = HIGH
Creates FraudIndicator records with category API_VERIFY
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: NHTSA VIN decoder is a free public API. License verification starts as mock.

userStories.title: Phase 2: Cross-submission entity resolution
userStories.description: As the system, I need to detect the same entity appearing across unrelated submissions (fraud ring indicator).
acceptanceCriteria: Service function resolveEntities(submissionId): extracts key entity identifiers (owner names, EINs, addresses, phone numbers, agent names) from the submission
Fuzzy matches these identifiers against ALL other submissions in the tenant's database (and optionally cross-tenant with anonymized matching)
Flag: same beneficial owner appearing in >2 unrelated submissions = CRITICAL
Flag: same address used across unrelated submissions = HIGH
Flag: same agent with >25% of submissions falling outside appetite = MEDIUM
Creates FraudIndicator records with category ENTITY_INTEL and evidence showing matched submissions
Uses fuzzy string matching (Levenshtein distance) for name comparison, exact match for EIN/phone
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the beginning of the network graph moat (Phase 3 builds on this).

userStories.title: Update processing pipeline to include Phase 2 detection engines
userStories.description: As the system, I need the submission processing pipeline to run Phase 2 detection engines after Phase 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Update processSubmission orchestrator (from US-022) to include Phase 2 steps

After Phase 1 detection, run: entity verification (SOS, OFAC, broker license, address, EIN), image forensics, GenAI detection, template matching, broker letter NLP, VIN validation, professional license verification, cross-submission entity resolution
Phase 2 engines run only on relevant document types (e.g., image forensics only on INSPECTION_PHOTO documents)
Phase 2 engine failures don't block Phase 1 results -- partial results are still scored
Risk score recalculated after Phase 2 engines complete (includes all Phase 1 + Phase 2 indicators)
Typecheck passes
